name: DOMS Industries Ltd
title: DOMS Industries Ltd - 544045 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Q4 revenue +18.7% to INR604 cr but EBITDA margin fell to 16.7% on a 15-20% raw-material inflation against only 4-5% pass-through; Q1 margins guided slightly under pressure.

capex.quote: we have lined up a capex plan between INR250 crores to INR275 crores for FY27.

triggers.label: Raw material +15-17% vs price action 4-5%
triggers.quote: we have seen our raw material cost increase by approximately 15% to 17%, while the pricing actions taken so far are around 4% to 5%

triggers.label: Q1 margins under pressure
triggers.quote: we do expect margins in Q1 to remain slightly under pressure versus the corresponding period last year

triggers.label: Capex raised to INR250-275 cr for FY27
triggers.quote: we have lined up a capex plan between INR250 crores to INR275 crores for FY27.

triggers.label: Imports pricier after rupee weakness
triggers.quote: The currency fluctuation probably has made imports slightly expensive.

guidance.quote: we expect revenue to grow by 17% to 20% in FY27. It's the same guidance that we had in the previous call.
we have lined up a capex plan between INR250 crores to INR275 crores for FY27.
we'll be happy to achieve a 10% sort of an EBITDA and stay at that level

prior_guidance_check.quote: Our revenue for the year grew by 21.6%, surpassing our full year guidance.

red_flags.label: FY26 free cash flow negative; capex above plan
red_flags.quote: this year, we were not able to generate any free cash flow

red_flags.label: Uniclan margin down to 6.3% in Q4

evasions.quote: providing a definitive margin profile for FY27 at this point of time would be a little difficult.

evasions.topic: Market share and channel stocking metrics
evasions.quote: We typically don't evaluate or measure the market share or the size of the market number
